jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

We are seeking to hire a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Software Engineer for our Equities department. Our goal is to build innovative tools that transform complex sustainability data into actionable insights for responsible financial decisions. As an early, high-impact member of the team, you will take ownership of architecting and building these intuitive, end-to-end systems.

Your role

• Designing, building and maintaining end-to-end web applications, including front-end, back-end, and database layers.

• Implementing agentic AI capabilities into content tools and drive adoption of AI workflows and best practices.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design intuitive high-quality UIs that make complex data easy to understand and navigate.

Your profile

• Proven experience in building a great product or 7+ years of professional experience.

• Early adopter of agentic engineering practices, with a strong grasp of the current AI ecosystem (frameworks, tooling, and workflows).

• Strong full-stack fundamentals: React, TypeScript/JavaScript on the frontend; Python and REST/GraphQL APIs on the backend; SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Hands-on experience deploying and operating solutions end-to-end (ideally in AWS), including data ingestion, transformation, and serving, with solid practices around testing, versioning, and observability.

• Entrepreneurial drive and a sharp analytical mindset, with the ability to quickly ramp up on new domains, tools, and techniques through self-learning.

• Fluent in English.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

What we offer

• Full ownership of a strategic product from an early stage, shaping its architecture, data flows, and AI capabilities.

• An environment that encourages experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

• Close collaboration with experienced engineers and non-technical users.

• Flexible working arrangements and high quality working environment.

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

REF.: FSE/CM/VK

Note

Diversity & Inclusion

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Transaction Officer - Cash to join our Banking Operations team . The primary responsibility of this role is to process IN/OUT payment transactions efficiently and accurately, ensuring seamless operations across various payment systems and customer categories.

Your role

• Process, invoice, and validate payment orders across systems such as TARGET, SEPA (SCT/SDD), and cash correspondent networks

• Handle transactions for all customer categories, including PWM, PAS FRONT, FPS, and PAM PAI, in all currencies and for all BPAG entities (7 Business Units)

• Manage incoming SWIFT MX and SEPA messages (Pacs.00x & Camt.0xx)

• Reconcile suspense items and monitor investigation files

• Ensure accurate accounting of incoming funds via SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET, and BACS for our customers

• Analyze and process reversals, cheque cashing, and issue requests

• Perform first-level processing of Fircosoft hits

• Manage standing orders, including creation, validation, and closure

• Process SWIFT FreeText eT Broadcast messages

• Enter, correct, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages in the AMH system

• Ensure that risk management is controlled at every stage of operations processing, including during the updating of procedures

• Analyze existing processes to identify productivity gains and apply Agile and Lean working methods

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Minimum Bac +2 or equivalent in Economics

• At least 3 years of experience in a "Custodian Bank / Custody" department

• Proficiency in back-office transfer processes

• Familiarity with IT tools such as Avaloq, AMH, Swift, Fircosoft, Jira, Lotus (suspense tracking), Idoc, AvaloqOrderList Loader, and Luxis

• Strong knowledge of MS Office software

• Understanding of SEPA, TARGET, and BACS payment systems

• Strong interest and ease in using new technologies as well as IT tools (Artificial Intelligence, VBA, Python, Power Query, etc.)

Soft skills:

• Strong analytical skills and a willingness to learn

• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure

• Team-oriented mindset with empathy and excellent communication skills

• High level of discretion and confidentiality

• Spirit of innovation, curiosity, and a taste for process improvement

Language skills:

• Fluent in French

• Good knowledge of English

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

La responsabilità primaria di questo ruolo è di elaborare le transazioni di pagamento IN/OUT in modo efficiente e preciso, garantendo operazioni senza interruzioni in vari sistemi di pagamento e categorie di clienti.

Il tuo ruolo

• Elaborare, fatturare e convalidare gli ordini di pagamento attraverso sistemi come TARGET, SEPA (SCT/SDD), e le reti corrispondenti in contanti

• Gestione delle transazioni per tutte le categorie di clienti, tra cui PWM, PAS FRONT, FPS e PAM PAI, in tutte le valute e per tutte le entità BPAG (7 Business Units)

• Gestione dei messaggi SWIFT MX e SEPA in entrata (Pacs.00x & Camt.0xx)

• Reconcile suspense elementi e monitorare i file di indagine

• Assicurare una contabilità accurata dei fondi in entrata tramite SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET e BACS per i nostri clienti

• Analizzare e processare inversioni, assegno in contanti, e rilasciare richieste

• Eseguire la lavorazione di primo livello di colpi Fircosoft

• Gestire gli ordini in piedi, tra cui creazione, convalida e chiusura

• Processo SWIFT FreeText eT Trasmissione messaggi

• Inserire, correggere, verificare e autorizzare i messaggi SWIFT nel sistema AMH

• Assicurarsi che la gestione dei rischi sia controllata in ogni fase del trattamento, anche durante l'aggiornamento delle procedure

• Analizzare i processi esistenti per identificare i guadagni di produttività e applicare i metodi di lavoro Agile e Lean

Il tuo profilo

Esperienza richiesta:

• Bac minimo +2 o equivalente in Economia

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un reparto "Custodian Bank / Custody"

• Proficienza nei processi di trasferimento back-office

• Familiarità con gli strumenti IT come Avaloq, AMH, Swift, Fircosoft, Jira, Lotus (inseguimento), Idoc, AvaloqOrderList Loader, e Luxis

• Forte conoscenza del software MS Office

• Comprensione dei sistemi di pagamento SEPA, TARGET e BACS

• Forte interesse e facilità nell'utilizzo di nuove tecnologie e strumenti IT (Intelligenza Artificiale, VBA, Python, Power Query, ecc.)

Morbide competenze:

• Forte capacità analitiche e la volontà di imparare

• Capacità di rispettare le scadenze e di lavorare sotto pressione

• mentalità orientata al team con empatia e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• Alto livello di discrezione e riservatezza

• Spirito di innovazione, curiosità e un gusto per il miglioramento del processo

Capacità linguistiche:

• Fluente in francese

• Buona conoscenza dell'inglese

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. Tale documento sarà richiesto con l'obiettivo di effettuare un controllo del carattere sui candidati, tenendo presente l'area di attività del nostro stabilimento e, più in particolare, i compiti descritti nella descrizione del lavoro.

Dein Team

Die Pictet Group ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit 1989 in Luxemburg präsent und beschäftigt dort über 700 Mitarbeiter.

Operationen bieten eine sichere und effiziente Verarbeitung der Bankgeschäfte und Investmentfonds von Pictet. Unsere Teams stellen sicher, dass alle Aktivitäten den Vorschriften entsprechen und Risiken managen.
Durch die Entwicklung und Pflege einer modernen, robusten Infrastruktur garantieren wir zuverlässige, qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen für Pictet Wealth Management, Asset Management und Immobilienkunden.

Wir suchen einen engagierten und detailorientierten Transaction Officer - Cash, um unserem Banking Operations Team beizutreten. Die Hauptverantwortung dieser Rolle liegt darin, IN/OUT-Zahlungstransaktionen effizient und präzise zu verarbeiten und einen nahtlosen Betrieb über verschiedene Zahlungssysteme und Kundenkategorien hinweg sicherzustellen.

Deine Rolle

• Verarbeitung, Rechnung und Validierung von Zahlungsaufträgen über Systeme wie TARGET, SEPA (SCT/SDD) und Bargeldkorrespondenznetzwerke hinweg

• Abwicklung von Transaktionen für alle Kundenkategorien, einschließlich PWM, PAS FRONT, FPS und PAM PAI, in allen Währungen und für alle BPAG-Unternehmen (7 Business Units)

• Verwalten Sie eingehende SWIFT MX- und SEPA-Nachrichten (Pacs.00x & Camt.0xx)

• Abstimmung von Suspense Items und Überwachung von Ermittlungsdateien

• Sicherstellen einer genauen Buchführung der eingehenden Gelder über SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET und BACS für unsere Kunden

• Analysieren und Verarbeiten von Umkehrungen, Scheckeinlösung und Ausgabeanforderungen

• Führen Sie die First-Level-Verarbeitung von Fircosoft-Hits durch

• Verwaltung von Daueraufträgen, einschließlich Erstellung, Validierung und Schließung

• Prozess SWIFT FreeText eT Broadcast Nachrichten

• Eingabe, Korrektur, Überprüfung und Autorisierung von SWIFT-Nachrichten im AMH-System

• Gewährleistung, dass das Risikomanagement in jeder Phase der operativen Verarbeitung kontrolliert wird, auch während der Aktualisierung der Verfahren

• Analysieren Sie bestehende Prozesse, um Produktivitätsgewinne zu identifizieren und agile und schlanke Arbeitsmethoden anzuwenden

Geforderte Erfahrung:

• Minimum Bac +2 oder gleichwertig in Wirtschaft

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Abteilung "Custodian Bank / Custody"

• Kenntnisse in Back-Office-Transferprozessen

• Vertrautheit mit IT-Tools wie Avaloq, AMH, Swift, Fircosoft, Jira, Lotus (Suspense Tracking), Idoc, AvaloqOrderList Loader und Luxis

• Starke Kenntnisse der MS Office Software

• Verständnis von SEPA-, TARGET- und BACS-Zahlungssystemen

• Starkes Interesse und einfache Nutzung neuer Technologien sowie IT-Tools (Künstliche Intelligenz, VBA, Python, Power Query, etc.)

Soft Skills:

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Lernbereitschaft

• Fähigkeit, Termine einzuhalten und unter Druck zu arbeiten

• Teamorientiertes Mindset mit Empathie und exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Hohe Diskretion und Vertraulichkeit

• Geist der Innovation, Neugier und Geschmack für Prozessverbesserung

• Fließend auf Französisch

• Gute Englischkenntnisse

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un agent de transaction dédié et axé sur les détails - Cash pour rejoindre notre équipe des opérations bancaires . La responsabilité première de ce rôle est de traiter les opérations de paiement IN/OUT de manière efficace et précise, en assurant des opérations sans heurts entre différents systèmes de paiement et catégories de clients.

• Gérer les messages SWIFT MX et SEPA entrants (Pacs.00x & Catt.0xx)

• Réconcilier les éléments d'attente et surveiller les dossiers d'enquête

• Assurer une comptabilisation précise des fonds entrants via SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET et BACS pour nos clients

• Analyser et traiter les inversions, l'encaissement des chèques et les demandes d'émission

• Effectuer le traitement de premier niveau des hits Fircosoft

• Gérer les commandes permanentes, y compris la création, la validation et la clôture

• Veiller à ce que la gestion des risques soit contrôlée à chaque étape du traitement des opérations, y compris lors de la mise à jour des procédures

• Analyser les processus existants pour identifier les gains de productivité et appliquer les méthodes de travail Agile et Lean

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un département de "Banque Custodie / Garde"

• Compétence dans les processus de transfert back-office

• Familiarité avec les outils informatiques tels qu'Avaloq, AMH, Swift, Fircosoft, Jira, Lotus (suivi suspense), Idoc, AvaloqOrderList Loader, et Luxis

• Niveau élevé de discrétion et de confidentialité

A position is open for a Business Oversight Manager for UK PWM. The Business Oversight Manager is a key role in the Management Team reporting to the head of Business Oversight for UK PWM.

Your role

• Ownership of the execution of the Consumer Duty framework, including fair value assessments, qualitative and quantitative testing against defined good outcomes, vulnerable clients analysis and assessments.

• Responsible for the execution of business control and oversight activities including sample testing, data analytics, and review of output from centralised control functions, with the goal of confirming compliance with UK regulatory requirements and firm policies.

• Reporting of results to the COO and development of proposals to remediate findings and improve our ways of working.

• Provide input to the development of the London Branch oversight framework, including the development of new activities and opportunities for efficiency.

• Support the CEO of London Branch by providing regular and ad-hoc sales management data analysis and reporting, including book analysis, revenue analysis etc.

• Support the Head of Business Oversight and COO in the preparation of materials for governance meetings and regulatory reporting (e.g. Executive Committee and Consumer Duty Board Report).

• Participate in periodic reviews and projects, including new products/services and regulatory implementations.

• Manage and develop access to key data/information sources of the London Branch (including tableaus/system extracts and other means).

• Assist in preparation of response to regulatory/audit enquiries.

Your profile

• The role requires interactions with many different functions of the firm from Relationship Managers and Investment Specialists in the front office to Compliance, Finance, Operations and Technology. The ideal candidate should be able to interact effectively with these functions and stakeholder manage.

• The role has a wide and interesting scope, requiring candidates to have at least 3 years prior experience in wealth management or similar role.

• The role has a particular focus on data analytics and risk/control activities, therefore EXCEL skills (formulae) and experience handling larger sets of data are essential.

• Degree educated (or equivalent). Numerical or IT discipline preferred e.g. accounting, economics, finance.

• Motivated, proactive and energetic self-starter who takes ownership.

• Detail oriented with an investigative mindset, coupled with strong ability to critically analyse data and produce accurate, reconcilable output. Be able to take judgement.

• Good organizational skills - manage and prioritise multiple tasks across different time horizons within deadlines.

• Knowledge/experience of wealth management services and investment products, as well as wealth management regulatory landscape.

• Excellent MS skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint. Interest in AI developments.

The ideal candidate will have existing experience working within risk or compliance of a UK wealth manager and have a strong interest in developing a career within this industry. They will be proactive and organised with an eye for detail, be able to efficiently and critically analyse data, and produce quality output.

• Assistere in preparazione alla risposta alle richieste di controllo/audit.

• Il ruolo richiede interazioni con molte diverse funzioni dell'azienda da Relationship Managers e Investment Specialists in front office a Compliance, Finance, Operations and Technology. Il candidato ideale dovrebbe essere in grado di interagire efficacemente con queste funzioni e gestione degli stakeholder.

• Motivato, proattivo ed energico autostarter che prende la proprietà.

• Particolare orientato con una mentalità investigativa, unita alla forte capacità di analizzare criticamente i dati e produrre output accurati e riconciliabili. Sii in grado di giudicare.

• Conoscenza/esperienza dei servizi di gestione della ricchezza e dei prodotti di investimento, così come il paesaggio regolamentare della gestione della ricchezza.

• Competenze di MS eccellenti, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint. Interessi sugli sviluppi dell'IA.

Il candidato ideale avrà esperienza esistente lavorando all'interno del rischio o della conformità di un gestore di ricchezza del Regno Unito e avrà un forte interesse a sviluppare una carriera all'interno di questo settore.
